abstract: A 59-year-old man was admitted with giant tumor of testis and massive hemorrhage into accompanying hydrocele. His clinical status had become worse quickly. The emergency resection of tumor with hematocele was performed. The diagnosis was made upon histological examination of the postoperative tissue and was confirmed by immunohistochemistry. Spermatocytic seminoma was recognized. The surgical specimen comprised a tumor (26 cm x 28 cm x 17 cm) in size, weighed 2150 g. Tumor with hematocele achieved about 40 cm in diameter.
abstract_ja: 59歳男性が巨大精巣腫瘍と水瘤への大量出血により受診し、急速に全身状態が悪化しました。緊急に腫瘍と血腫の切除を行いました。術後組織の病理組織学的検査で診断され、免疫組織化学により確定されました。精母細胞性セミノーマと同定されました。摘出標本の腫瘍は26cm×28cm×17cm、重量は2150gで、血腫を含めた直径は約40cmでした。
